Lemma verified both as rational-function identity (3k+1=2m for k=3 mod 4 with m=(3k+1)/2; 3k+3=2m for k=1 mod 4 with m=3(k+1)/2, c=k*m) and by exact Fraction sweep for all odd k in [3,3999] plus iterated E1..E4 with sums exactly 1, odd/distinct, strictly increasing maxima 135,82215,30417001335,4163372866005888522015,78001531296273387817009252900320853961254035. Iteration argument is a valid induction: children exceed current max so freshness/distinctness preserved, oddness preserved, sum preserved, so infinite distinct odd maxima follow from hand proof, not from finite sweep. Obstruction lemma is correct: L=lcm(S), L=sum L/d; if v=v_p(M) uniquely maximal then v_p(L)=v, v_p(L/M)=0 while v_p(L/d)>=1 for d!=M, so RHS not 0 mod p while LHS divisible by p when v>=1. Corollary for M=p^k holds because d<M implies v_p(d)<k (else p^k|d). Subset-exhaustion for max 3,5,7,11 confirms instances. DRAFT proof text has a garbled inline algebra fragment but the stated identities and final equalities are correct as re-derived. Boundary conditions (k>=3, strict max, M>1, v>=1 for prime-power case) all satisfied.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Martin math/9811112 settles general (non-parity) largest/second-largest program with density-zero exceptional set and order of growth — no odd restriction, no which-odd-maxima theorem. Elsholtz 1606.02117 proves double-exponential counting bounds S(k) for odd k — enumeration only. Chen-Elsholtz-Jiang 1108.6118 proves T_o lower bounds and arithmetic-progression infinitude in number of terms — counting only. Louwsma-Martino 2309.07280 classifies odd-greedy fixed-length expansions with finiteness open — greedy-length taxonomy only. Martin-Shi 2107.05076 gives general restricted-denominator enumeration algorithm — method only, no odd largest-denominator result. Live arXiv API checks corroborate gap: all:Egyptian AND all:odd returns 5 hits (modular-category, odd-counting x2, fusion-ring x2), none on odd largest denominators; 'largest denominator' AND Egyptian returns only Martin 9811112 and 9804045; largest-denominator+odd returns only unrelated Gamma0 paper; prime-power+largest-denominator returns 0; Egyptian+valuation returns 0. Counting lower bounds imply unboundedness abstractly but do not construct explicit parametric realizability family nor any obstructed residue subfamily. The two-sided odd largest-denominator statement (explicit odd splitting family + prime-power obstruction with 3-mod-4 infinite subfamily) is absent from all nearest priors at classification level.

value.rationale: Strongest headline judged separately: two-sided odd Martin-type theorem for the natural object 'distinct odd-denominator expansions of 1 classified by largest denominator,' motivated before computation by the Erdos-Graham/Martin largest-denominator program and the Breusch/van Albada/Elsholtz odd-expansion program. (a) gives first explicit infinite realizable odd maxima via residue-dependent odd splitting identities iterated from E0; (b) gives infinite obstructed odds via p-adic lemma (all prime powers, hence all odd primes and {3^{2j+1}} all 3 mod 4). Values are not known or mechanically implied: counting bounds do not tell which maxima occur. Scope is infinite families/classes fixed by construction/lemma, no solver cap enters statement. Honestly bounded: obstruction is prime-power infinite set with 3-mod-4 infinite subfamily, not a fully blocked class, as DRAFT/report transparently state — this does not erase the exact headline invariants. A future researcher needs these precise facts (construction, identities, maxima, obstruction). Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
